title: Design staging and production closure without provisioning
summary_zh: 完成 Pantheon Dev/Staging/Prod 環境閉環 SA/SD 規範，實測複核並確認 Staging 與 Production 處於 unavailable 狀態；全面廢止並刪除舊 suspended 專案 pantheon-benjamin-20260528 與已釋出 IP 104.155.223.192 之後門與重複使用假設；設計 Ephemeral 0-idle Staging 與生產 Control/Execution 實體隔離邊界架構；並將後續實作具體物化為 3 個處於 undispatched 且需 Operator MFA 批准之未來特權任務封包。

owned: Target SA and SD specification for Dev, Ephemeral Staging, and Isolated Production (Prod Control VM + Prod Execution VM)
Re-verification and empirical probing of Staging/Production unavailability (probe of 35.201.239.38 timeout, 104.155.223.192 third-party k8s reallocation)
Mandatory deletion and repudiation of retired environment reuse assumptions
Authority separation and threat modeling across Operator, CI/CD, Product Runtime, and Execution planes
Resource sizing and cost model based on Phase 0 live measurements (e2-standard-2 / e2-standard-4 with >=30% memory headroom)
Exact-pair promotion and sub-2-minute rollback specification with database expand/contract protocol
Materialization of undispatched, privileged future implementation packets (ENV-STG-EPHEMERAL-IMPL-001, ENV-PROD-CONTROL-IMPL-001, ENV-PROD-EXEC-ISOLATE-001)
not_changing: No creation of cloud resources, VMs, disks, networks, or VPCs
No generation of credentials, IAM keys, or Secret Manager secrets
No opening of network ingress or firewall ports
No production data access, copying, or replication
No live-capital trading enablement or execution trigger
known_gap: Physical provisioning of ephemeral staging templates and production GCP projects remains deferred to future implementation packets ENV-STG-EPHEMERAL-IMPL-001 and ENV-PROD-CONTROL-IMPL-001 pending explicit operator MFA authorization.
